data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis from 982a, CRITICAL): The sweep-pair emission must make each emitted pair-half task carry a reserved machine-readable tag migration-role:automated-sweep / migration-role:manual-verification so the sprint two-pass consumer (982a) can deterministically pair halves (the task_type field is not persisted as a queryable key). Specify in the task-decomposer prose that the emitted pair-half tasks include this role tag. Verify: grep -qiE 'migration-role' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
